lines: Some Ontario rivers reach Hudson Bay
through Lake Winnipeg and the Nelson River.
ontario.sourceLine: Via Lake Winnipeg and the Nelson River · International Joint Commission / Manitoba
ontario.note: Part of northwestern Ontario drains to Hudson Bay through Lake Winnipeg and the Nelson River.
ontario.intro: Rivers in Ontario, colored by river system. All outlets start together and advance at the same distance per second. Separate highlights show the farthest headwater overall and the longest route entirely within Ontario.
ontario.receivingNote: The Great Lakes are treated as endpoints. Northern connections to James Bay and Hudson Bay, including those through Manitoba, are visible during the fill.

sources.title: International Joint Commission — Lake of the Woods and Rainy River
